name: Tool Guard Core
summary: Tool Guard Core (github.com/dimaggi-ai/tool-guard-core, by DIMAGGI AI) is an Apache-2.0 open-source decision engine for AI agent actions: a proposed tool call sent to POST /evaluate, the Go library, or a bundled MCP bridge is checked against operator-authored YAML policies (deterministic rules plus semantic classifiers, one an optional LLM classifier), returning allow / deny / escalate with the rule that fired and a hash-chained audit log. Core decides and records; the caller enforces. The commercial Tool Guard Enterprise edition is the MCP enforcement gateway. Self-hosted; v0.8.1.

payments.notes: Tool Guard Core is Apache-2.0 open source with no usage limits (the README says nothing in it is gated), so there is no billing for Core. Tool Guard Enterprise is a separate commercial enforcement gateway product; its price is not published. No machine-payable surface.

agentAccess.notes: Self-hosted: run the Go binary or ghcr.io container, or embed the Go library; no vendor account or hosted key. The agent-facing decision call is POST /evaluate on your own tg-proxy, the CLI tg evaluate, or a bundled MCP bridge. Escalations use a single shared approver token. v0.8.1 (2026-10-17).

jobs.summary: POST /evaluate checks a proposed call against operator-authored YAML policies (deterministic rules and classifiers, one an optional model classifier), returning allow / deny / escalate before it runs. Operator-authored policy, not vendor-fixed; Core decides, caller enforces. README; not measured.
